title: GG Backups
description: A lightweight and reliable inventory backup system for your Minecraft server.
body:
### **A lightweight inventory backup system for your server.** *GG Backups automatically saves player inventories to a MySQL database or YAML, allowing administrators to restore lost items easily through an intuitive GUI.* ---
* 💾 **Smart Saving:** Toggle between interval auto-saves or saving only on death and logout. * 🖥️ **Management GUI:** Easy-to-use menu to browse, restore, and delete backups. * 🛡️ **Safety First:** Includes a confirmation screen before deleting any backup. * ⚡ **Full Async:** Database operations are handled in the background to prevent server lag. * 🕒 **Time Tracking:** Each backup includes a precise date and time of creation.
Commands
> ` /backup [player] `  –  **Open the backup menu.** > > ` /backup reload `  –  **Reload the configuration.**
---
